title: ICA: Information-Aware Credit Assignment for Visually Grounded Long-Horizon Information-Seeking Agents
abstract: arXiv:2602.10863v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Long-horizon reinforcement learning for information seeking agents remains difficult because terminal rewards reveal whether the final answer is correct, but not which acquired information enabled it. This difficulty is amplified by text-derived webpage observations, where parsing, truncation, and summarization often produce incomplete and unstable content representations across trajectories. We propose an evidence-centric framework for web agent learning that represents information acquired through tools as identifiable units for comparison across trajectories. In particular, fetched webpages are represented as rendered snapshots, preserving layout and multimodal content as stable content-level observations. Building on these units, we introduce Information-Aware Credit Assignment, a post hoc reward propagation method that estimates turn-level utility scores from rollout success rates and assigns dense rewards to intermediate

translated_title: ICA：面向视觉基础的长时程信息搜寻代理的信息感知信用分配
translated_abstract: arXiv:2602.10863v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：长时程强化学习对于信息搜寻代理仍然困难，因为终端奖励仅揭示最终答案是否正确，而未指明是哪些获取的信息促成了该答案。这一困难因文本衍生的网页观察而加剧，其中解析、截断和摘要常常在轨迹间产生不完整和不稳定的内容表示。我们提出了一种以证据为中心的网页代理学习框架，该框架将通过工具获取的信息表示为可识别的单元，以便在轨迹间进行比较。特别是，获取的网页被表示为渲染快照，保留布局和多模态内容作为稳定的内容级观察。基于这些单元，我们引入了信息感知信用分配，这是一种事后奖励传播方法，通过回滚成功率估计回合级效用分数，并为中间步骤分配密集奖励。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种信息感知信用分配框架，通过将网页观察表示为稳定渲染快照并利用事后奖励传播，解决了长时程信息搜寻代理中终端奖励无法指示关键信息获取步骤的难题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an information-aware credit assignment framework that represents web observations as stable rendered snapshots and uses post hoc reward propagation to address the challenge of terminal rewards failing to indicate key information-acquisition steps in long-horizon information-seeking agents.
